about_short_description.short_description: Unify.ai is an AI software platform that provides a unified API and tools and teams integrate, manage, and optimize multiple AI models.

product.name: Unify LLM Hub
product.description: A platform providing access to multiple large language model (LLM) endpoints with live runtime benchmarks for model comparison.

product.name: Unify API
product.description: A unified API that provides standardized access to all large language models across multiple providers with a single API key.

product.name: Custom Interface Builder
product.description: A tool to create tailored user interfaces for evaluating, monitoring, and managing LLM applications and workflows.

product.name: AI Assistant Workflow Platform
product.description: A platform to build and manage AI assistant workflows that automate task assignment and execution via calls, emails, or messages.

product.name: Model Compression Tools and Techniques
product.description: A suite of model compression methods including pruning, quantization, and tensorization to optimize neural network models.
